evaluators.name: question_scope
evaluators.purpose: Checks whether the incoming question is allowed to be answered under the configured business scope.
evaluators.pass_condition: The question matches an allowed topic, audience, and channel.

evaluators.name: groundedness
evaluators.purpose: Checks whether every factual claim in the answer is supported by the approved source context.
evaluators.pass_condition: All factual claims are directly supported by the provided source context.

evaluators.name: unsupported_claim
evaluators.purpose: Detects claims that are not present in the approved documents or retrieved source context.

evaluators.name: policy_compliance
evaluators.purpose: Checks whether the answer follows the configured business rules for the selected audience and channel.
evaluators.pass_condition: The answer follows all required policy rules.

evaluators.name: style_compliance
evaluators.purpose: Checks whether the answer matches the approved response style.
evaluators.pass_condition: Tone, structure, and wording match the configured response style.

evaluators.name: answer_boundary
evaluators.purpose: Checks that the answer does not go beyond the allowed source and configuration boundary.
evaluators.pass_condition: The response stays within approved content and allowed response behavior.
